coverage_note: I could not open data/lesson-work/echo-candidates/2026-10-09.json, so no 'echo:' entries. Chat lines lag the voice by 30-120 s and I used them only for context and spelling. Engine mishearings I treated as pronunciation or engine, not errors: ألأ for أقل (07:55), أكلب for أغلب (06:04), غادة for غابة (27:05), 'Persian vazeh' attempt (57:02), the 06:08 'لسه' line, and the 'مع الشوق بك' goodbye (1:10:34, possibly مع السلامة). I skipped the English stretches (about 33:20-34:30 and 53:00-53:33) and Amal's side remarks. Plural rows are filed as grammar A9/A9b, not vocab tier 2. Rows 1, 2, 14, 16, 24, 36 and 43 are low confidence.

rows.why: He said 'mouth' (فمي) when he meant belly. Amal asked 'Your mouth hurts?' and he fixed it to بطني.
بوجع means 'I hurt'. The subject is 'it' (my stomach), so the verb should be بيوجع. Amal let it pass.
She had said نعنع at 04:12. He said نانا (the Persian word) and she recast it as نعنع. Sheet: na3na3 | نعنع.

rows.medi_said: أطلب، إلها ... is it أطلب لها؟
rows.amal_said: You're gonna ask of her? ... or you're gonna order for her?
rows.why: 'Ask something of her' takes the preposition من. Amal prompted in English, he said 'أطلب منها' and she said ممتاز.
Amal recast 'the words of nature' as an idafa: كلمات الطبيعة. He had used a singular word and an adjective-style plural instead.

rows.amal_said: لا، طبيعة just nature. Don't have plural of nature.
rows.why: He invented a plural, الطبيعات. Amal said طبيعة has no plural.
Asked how to say 'my favorite' on its own, he gave bare المفضل. She said no to his guesses (إشي، هو) and gave المفضل عندي.
Amal recast his bare بوظة حلوة as البوظة الحلوة (el- for ice cream in general). He accepted: 'ice cream in general. Yeah'.
بوظة is feminine, so the adjective should be المفضلة. Amal's chat typed mufaddala. At 16:14 he says 'you didn't correct me' and she says she did not hear it.
Amal gave the plural مسلسلات after he proposed مسلسلين. He repeated it right.

rows.medi_said: الـ مفضل الـ ... مفضل الـ. الـ مفضل الـ.
rows.why: He put المفضل before the noun. Amal said no three times. It follows the noun, as in بوظتي المفضلة.

rows.amal_said: No. This is my favorite. ... my favorite's on its own, so we use the new way. جبال means my mountains.
rows.why: He added my- to جبال, but 'favorite' already carries 'mine' through عندي. Amal said no. He then said المفضلين عندي.
Amal asked 'So one mountain is' and he answered with the plural جبال. She gave the singular جبل.

rows.amal_said: Wow, you remember many words. So beach is
rows.why: He used the MSA word الشاطئ. Amal asked 'So beach is' and he said شط. Her chat spells it el-shatt. Sheet: sha66 | شط.
'The other lake' needs el-noun el-taani. Amal said 'We corrected this fact' and recast it. He said 'Oh, that's right'.
He is talking to Amal (female), so the verb should be بتحبي. Only her chat shows it (bet7ebbi) and she said nothing aloud. The line is cut off.
rows.english: if you don't like this beach

rows.why: شط is masculine, so it takes هذا. Amal said هذا and he repeated هذا الشاطئ.
He asked for the word. Amal gave غابة and spelled out the ب. Sheet: 8aabe | غابة.

rows.amal_said: غابة. ... Yes، بس غابة is what? ... It is so واحد أو واحدة.
rows.why: غابة is feminine, so 'one' must be واحدة. Amal prompted ('بس غابة is what?') and he fixed it: 'I even knew that saying it'.

rows.medi_said: أنا بر-- I go to أنا بروح أو أنا بروحها.
rows.amal_said: أنا بروح to. ... بروح عليها. I go to.
rows.why: 'Go to' takes على plus the ending, as in بروح عليها. He offered بروحها as a guess and Amal gave the fix.
rows.english: the first one I go to

rows.amal_said: No. It's the M group... مناظر.
rows.why: منظر has a broken plural. Amal said no, gave the M-group hint and then مناظر. His second guess مناظير was also wrong (same moment).

rows.medi_said: أنا جبت، جبتك. ... جبتك or لك؟
rows.amal_said: I brought to you. ... mm، جبت لك.
rows.chat: ana jebtillek warda taanie 3ashan 3id milaadek el-yoam
rows.why: 'Brought (to) you' needs the preposition لـ. جبتك would mean 'I brought you'. Amal said 'I brought to you', then جبت لك.
غير never takes el-. Amal finished it with غير نوع.
He used the plural أنواع for 'a different type'. Right after Amal's line he said 'Oh, نوع'. Her words are unclear here.

rows.medi_said: Is it the same mukhtalif anwa? Mukhtalif nuwa?
rows.amal_said: لا، نوع مختلف. 'Cause مختلف is just an adjective.
rows.why: He guessed the adjective could come first. Amal said no; it follows the noun.
'The beginning of my day' is awal + a noun with its own ending. Amal said 'My day.' and he fixed it to من أول يومي, then she said mm-hmm.
rows.english: since the beginning of my day

rows.chat: min awal yoami, ana jarrabet anwaa3 mu5talefeen min el-akel

rows.why: Numbers 3-10 take a plural noun. He used singular ورقة, and Amal's chat shows talat wara2aat. Her voiced 'add' is unclear.

rows.amal_said: ال never غير، غير never ends.
rows.why: Amal stated the rule: غير never takes el-. He fixed it to غير ورقة.
كمان meaning 'another' goes before the noun. Amal pushed ('Come on, what else?') and he said كمان ورقة. She then stated the rule.
Amal wanted 'have grass in them', fihom. She said 'In them.' and he said 'Oh، فيهم'.

rows.why: Amal asked 'Do you remember clear?' He guessed the Persian cognate and she supplied واضح. Sheet: waade7 | واضح.

rows.medi_said: آخر سؤالي ... would it be سؤالي آخر إلي؟
rows.amal_said: What would it means? ... No? It has two ways ... سؤالي الأخير. Or آخر سؤال إلي.

rows.why: 'The other game' needs el-noun el-taani. Amal said 'Mm-mm' and recast it as اللعبة التانية. He confirmed ('that's right').
لعبة has a broken plural, ألعاب. Amal supplied it and he repeated ألعاب.

rows.amal_said: أي، أي، أي، أي، أي. ألعاب.

rows.chat: lu3beti el-a5eera / aa5er lu3be ili hoan el-yoam
rows.why: آخر + a noun with an ending means 'the end of'. Amal explained, noted اللعبة is feminine, and he fixed it to لعبتي الأخيرة.

rows.amal_said: No, آخر اللعبة means end of.
rows.why: Amal said no: آخر + el-noun means 'the end of the game'. For 'last game' use آخر لعبة. He fixed it to هادي آخر لعبة إلي.
rows.english: this is the last game I'm here for

rows.amal_said: كان and آخر. So كان بيزهى. ... I'm talking about the end of the game, not the game itself.
rows.why: The subject is آخر (the end), which is masculine, so the verb is كان, and the 'it makes boring' verb is بيزهق, not بتزهق. Amal explained it, and her chat shows kaan beyzahhe2.
rows.english: the end of the game was boring
